sources: dossier=silent on cascade-mode locality (not in dossier's scope); doc=wait-set.md:13,31 said 'per-template cascade-mode rule'; code=lib/graph/node/template_validator.go validates TemplateNodeDef.CascadeMode per node def, GetCascadeMode(nodeID) reads per-node column; concept:cascade-mode.md:34 states 'The mode is per-node' as its own authoritative definition
note: cascade-mode is owned by concept:cascade-mode, whose doc explicitly says 'per-node' and matches the per-node column/validator in code; wait-set.md's 'per-template' wording at two sites contradicted its own neighbor concept. Corroborated by code + the neighbor concept doc, so treated as known intent even though the wait-set dossier itself is silent on this point.
